turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Before you say anything else, tell me who decided that, and on what basis.
"Get this over with." Okay. Who decided, Hale, and on what basis?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My son doesn't lie, and he didn't cheat. "Everyone knows it." Who is everyone, Hale, and where is your document, because without one I'm in the principal's office before my 4:40 call.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I'm writing that down. I asked you for one document, Hale, and you've given me an insult. Do you have anything, yes or no?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call me before any mark goes in, and you didn't. Withdraw the zero, or I walk straight upstairs to the principal when I leave this room. Your choice, Hale.
